title: College basketball
notes: Replayed on 2023-24 to 2025-26 (16,395 games): the ratings picked the winner 71.5% of the time, the closing line 72.3%. Priced from DraftKings' line, not the ratings: replayed on 16,806 games they added nothing to the closing line (its miss moved -0.03 +/- 0.03 of the way with their disagreement on the margin, 0.00 +/- 0.03 on the total), so the chance is the line's own, spread by how far results land from a line (11 points on a spread, 17 on a total).
